rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_emphysema_pop_age(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	pop_group1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_group1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pop_group2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_group2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pop_group3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_group3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pop_group4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_group4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pop_group5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_group5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_emphysema_pop_age WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_emphysema_pop_age 
(
SELECT
	@id,p.hospcode,p.areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,b1,a1,b2,a2,b3,a3,b4,a4,b5,a5
FROM
		(
				SELECT hospcode,areacode
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='1' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as b1
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='2' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as b2
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='3' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as b3
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='4' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as b4
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='5' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as b5
				FROM
						t_person_sex_age1560
				WHERE
						substr(areacode,1,2)=@prov_c
				GROUP BY
						hospcode,areacode
		) as p LEFT JOIN
		(
				SELECT d_hospcode,d_pt_vhid
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='1'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a1
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  as a2
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a3
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a4
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a5
				FROM
					(		SELECT * 
							FROM 
										t_chronic 
							WHERE substr(diagcode,1,3) = 'J43'
										AND typedisch not in(1,2,7) AND nation=99 
										AND d_typearea in(1,3)
							GROUP BY cid ) as pt
				GROUP BY
						pt.d_hospcode,pt.d_pt_vhid
		) as d
		ON p.hospcode=d.d_hospcode and p.areacode = d.d_pt_vhid
		WHERE substr(p.areacode,1,2)=@prov_c
		GROUP BY p.hospcode,p.areacode

);
